title: Referee Bite
trend: Rock paper scissors food challenge (friends or family play rock paper scissors over a plate of food and the winner takes a big bite; Virlo current TikTok trends, Early/Rising, US) + Thanksgiving-week desserts — siblings Tamika and Rashad play for the last of Aunt June's peach cobbler with little cousin Benny as referee; they overthink and tie every round, and on every tie the referee takes a bite while the cobbler narrates its own end; twist: Aunt June's rule card says Benny is always the referee and these two have always tied since they were babies (forty ties over one meatball at Grandpa's birthday); button: a second cobbler, another tie, another referee bite
youtube_title: Rock paper scissors for the last of the cobbler. The referee kept eating it 🥧
description:
Tamika and Rashad play rock paper scissors for the last of Aunt June's peach cobbler. Little cousin Benny is the referee, and on every tie, the referee takes a bite. Then they read the rule card.

#cartoon #animation #funny #siblings #shorts

lines.text: Last piece of Aunt June's peach cobbler. Rock paper scissors. Winner takes a bite.
Winner takes a big bite. Then we go again. Until it is gone.
Hello. I am the cobbler. I would like a fair fight, please.
I am the referee. Aunt June said so. I have a whistle in my heart.
Okay. Ready. Rock, paper, scissors, shoot.
Rock and rock. Tie.
She always throws rock first. I knew it. So I threw rock. Why did I do that?
Because you think I think you think I will throw paper.
Stop thinking in my head. It is crowded in there.
Rule one. On a tie, the referee takes a bite.
What? Since when is there a rule one?
Since Aunt June wrote it on this card.
He took a big bite. A very confident bite.
Fine. Again. Rock, paper, scissors, shoot.
Scissors and scissors. Tie.
Why would you throw scissors? You never throw scissors.
Exactly. It was a surprise. For both of us, apparently.
Referee bite.
I am mostly crust now. I feel very exposed.
New plan. We look into each other's eyes. We read the soul.
Your soul says paper. Your soul has always said paper.
My soul says you are about to lose.
Shoot.
Paper and paper. That is three ties. Referee bite.
He is chewing with his whole face. I have never felt so appreciated.
I am closing my eyes. If I do not know, you cannot know.
Then I am closing mine. Now nobody knows anything.
Rock and rock. Your eyes were closed and you still tied.
That is not luck. That is family.
Benny. How much cobbler is left?
One bite. I am one bite of a cobbler. I have lived a full life.
Final round. No thinking. Pure instinct.
Pure instinct. Rock, paper, scissors.
Shoot.
Scissors and scissors.
Referee bite.
And I am gone. Tell the pie I said goodbye.
Benny. Give me that card.
Rule two. Benny is always the referee. Rule three. These two always tie.
Since they were babies. Enjoy, sweetie. Love, Aunt June.
She said you tied forty times at Grandpa's birthday. Over one meatball.
That meatball was never found.
Aunt June found it.
One brain in two bodies. And a little boy who is very full.
Wait. If we always tie, we just had to play against Benny.
Benny. Rock paper scissors. Right now. For our dignity.
Too late. The cobbler is gone. And I am getting sleepy.
Also, Aunt June made a second cobbler. It is in the oven.
Then we play for that one. Rashad. Ready.
Rock, paper, scissors, shoot.
Rock and rock. Referee bite.
I have a brother in the oven. Run, brother. Run.
